implementation_notes: Publish a crate plus its types; consumers generate or hand-write clients. Use `pact-reference` or a generated OpenAPI client, and mark deprecated items with `#[deprecated(note = "...")]` so the compiler drives the migration across every consumer build.
idiom_name: published crate with #[deprecated] driving the migration
code_sketch:
#[deprecated(note = "use customer_v2; removal after 2026-09")]
pub fn customer_lookup(id: &str) -> Result<Customer, Error>;
pitfalls: Semver-major version bumps for routine additions, so every consumer forks its own cadence
Deprecated items never actually removed, accumulating ambiguity
